acceptanceCriteria.text: Assign the managed PR state schema migration a unique next append-only migration version without rewriting already-released migration history.
`src/state/migrations.test.ts` passes and explicitly protects global version uniqueness.
A fresh database applies the managed PR state migration and contains `managed_pr_states`.
The four currently failing `src/workflow/domain/pr-lifecycle.test.ts` cases pass.
Upgrade/restart migration behavior remains idempotent for databases that already contain prior migration versions.

issue.title: fix: restore managed PR state migration after version collision
